verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.wise.com/llms.txt, which serves a structured Markdown index describing the Wise Platform payments API. The API reference pages are also served as raw .md files (e.g., api-reference/card-order/tag.md), so an agent can ingest the docs as Markdown. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt contents beyond its header (e.g., an llms-full.txt or full link coverage), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually using these docs.
